original_test_intent: Verify, for every populated E1.S backplane bay in the approved matrix, that the correctly identified NVMe receives power, enumerates normally and drives the bay's power indicator to the specification-defined solid green state.
original_method: Select the unique row; map chassis/backplane revision, bay label, slot/port and expected drive serial/model/firmware; determine whether insertion is hot-plug-approved or must be powered down; baseline bay, LED and preserved OS/BMC logs; a qualified operator uses ESD controls to insert the approved drive once, observes and photographs the exact bay LED from off/empty through powered solid green, while the agent reads NVMe identity and health; correlate photo, bay and serial; stop on mechanical resistance, power fault, unexpected LED or device error and leave hardware in the approved final state.
manual_activity: A qualified operator maps and inserts each approved E1.S drive using the required power/ESD procedure and directly observes and photographs the physical solid-green LED.
required_inputs: Chassis/backplane revision and complete bay-label to slot/port/controller mapping
Approved E1.S drive serial/model/firmware per bay and insertion/removal final state
Vendor hot-plug versus powered-down insertion and ESD/service procedure
Authoritative power-LED position/color/steady-state specification and stabilization time
safety_requirements: Verify hot-plug capability before insertion; otherwise power down through the approved procedure
Use ESD controls, correct orientation and latch; never force a connector
Preserve host/BMC logs and correlate new events by timestamp
Use authenticated SSH without plaintext password or host-key bypass for software corroboration
Stop on resistance, arcing/odor, wrong bay/drive, abnormal LED, missing device, power fault or NVMe/AER error; no repeated insertion
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity/map/specification and organize operator photo plus read-only inventory evidence
Collect complete `nvme list`, `nvme list-subsys` or equivalent and correlated host/BMC health after insertion
Do not physically insert/remove hardware, claim visual observation, infer LED from enumeration, clear logs, retry insertion or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve backplane/bay/drive map, hot-plug policy, LED oracle and final state
Define whether every physical bay or only populated/project bays are covered
Review correlated physical/software evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lsblk` and `nvme list` corroborate enumeration but do not test the required solid-green power LED. The embedded sshpass and disabled host-key verification are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator performs the approved insertion and photographs the exact bay's solid-green LED; agent collects authenticated read-only NVMe identity/health evidence and correlates it by serial and bay.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The E1.S insertion, backplane-slot scope, solid-green powered criterion and 10/10-minute estimate remain; full bay matrix and stabilization timing are pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate one-time safe physical insertion and direct bay-LED observation with exact NVMe serial/controller enumeration and health evidence for each required bay.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds collision-safe bay identity, hot-plug/ESD controls, off-to-solid-green transition timing and software correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Enumeration alone cannot prove LED color, position, steady state or wiring; an LED photo without serial/bay mapping cannot prove the correct drive was powered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: LED interpretation is physical and may be obscured by light pipes; inserting into a non-hot-plug or wrong bay can damage hardware or interrupt storage.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define `All E1.s` as every fitted bay, every supported bay or a project population subset and specify how empty/unavailable bays are recorded without forcing hardware insertion.
expected_evidence: SUT/backplane revision, bay-slot-controller map and expected drive serial/model/firmware
Per-bay pre/insertion/post photos showing exact location and solid-green steady LED
Authenticated full NVMe inventory/subsystem/health correlated to bay and serial
Preserved dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/AER, anomaly/recovery/final-state record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires physical insertion and solid-green LED observation. DeepSeek's software-only substitution is a review mismatch, not an ambiguous source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The power-LED objective is clear. Bay map, hardware, safe procedure and LED spec are supplyable prerequisites, so hybrid execution is approval-gated rather than blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2214 Wistron-HW-00489-V003: approve the chassis/backplane revision and complete E1.S bay-label/slot/controller to drive serial/model/firmware matrix, meaning of 'All E1.s', hot-plug versus powered-down insertion and ESD procedure, exact power-LED location/color/solid-state/stabilization oracle, software correlation, stop conditions, removal/final state and hardware recovery ownership.

review_improvement: Restores the missing physical LED and insertion coverage, adds safe service controls and ties each visual result to the correct bay and NVMe identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: A solid power LED is an optical output of the backplane/drive/light-pipe path; no NVMe command can directly observe it. Conversely, a green light without serial enumeration may belong to the wrong bay or a stale/other indicator. Both evidence channels must be correlated. The source requires insertion, so hot-plug support and ESD/mechanical controls determine whether the action is safe. Repeated reseating is not an acceptable automatic recovery because it can worsen connector damage.
